'''Cerberus Juvenile''' is a [[The Zamorakian Undercity#Minibosses|miniboss]] released with [[The Zamorakian Undercity]]. It is found in the first section of the dungeon, inside a house on the north side. It has the [[Smouldering Hide]] passive ability, which lowers the amount of damage it takes the further away from the Cerberus Juvenile players are. In order to do full damage, players must get within melee distance.

The Cerberus Juvenile will attack either with three simultaneous melee hits, or a combination of magic and ranged. It is also poisonous. Players can completely avoid taking damage by standing one space south of the door to the Cerberus Juvenile's room, at a cost of dealing somewhat reduced damage; the Cerberus will move in front of the door so that it and the player will be one space apart.
